label: Figure 16.6: A deflationary gap in the new classical model
alt: LRAS at Yf, an upward-sloping SRAS and AD shifting left from AD1 to AD2. In the short run output falls to Y1 below Yf, marked as the deflationary gap.
caption: The economy starts at Yf where AD1, SRAS and LRAS meet. AD then falls to AD2 (purple arrows), so short-run equilibrium moves along SRAS to a lower output Y1 and a lower price level P2. Output below Yf is the deflationary (recessionary) gap.
